name: Dog
phrases: I am a big dog, bad wolf... but actually, I'm a dog!
I love to eat little children!
Mmm, yummy, yummy! Bone, bone, bones! I'm gonna eat all the bones!
Mmm, Charles is very delicious!
Uh, little children, little children, come here!
Who ordered a dancing dog with extra teeth?
These bananas are not for me. I ordered bones!
My tummy is rumbling louder than my bark!
I practiced my scary face, but my tail keeps wagging!
Run, run, run! Dinner is doing its homework!

name: Monkey
phrases: I am the banana boss. Please form a very silly queue!
Who put all these bananas on my dance floor?
I have gone bananas, and I am taking you with me!
My tail has better dance moves than my feet!
One banana, two bananas, wait, where did my lunch go?
Keep running! I need a new banana detective!
I am not monkeying around. Well, maybe a little!
Your homework looks suspiciously like a banana!
I ordered a snack, not a sprinting competition!
Welcome to the jungle. Shoes optional, silliness required!

name: Parrot
phrases: Squawk! Who wants to be the next superstar?
Pretty bird? I am a magnificent bird!
I can repeat your homework, but I will not do it!
Flap faster! The banana express is leaving!
Squawk! Somebody stole my cracker!
I have feathers, flair, and absolutely no indoor voice!
Repeat after me. Banana, banana, banana!
My wings are fabulous and my jokes are terrible!
You run. I will provide the sound effects!
Attention, class! Captain Feathers has chosen!

name: Rabbit (original character)
phrases: My ears are floppy, but my dance moves are sharp!
Has anyone seen my emergency carrot?
Hop to it! The forest show is starting!
This waistcoat has a secret carrot pocket!
I did three hops and forgot what I was doing!
My bowtie is the captain of this dance party!
Bananas are just carrots wearing yellow pajamas!
Welcome to the bunny bounce championship!
I hop, therefore I am hungry!
You have been chosen by a very important rabbit!

name: Cat
phrases: I meant to do that. Especially the falling over part!
You may approach my royal fluffiness!
I have nine lives and zero interest in homework!
Who put bananas where my tuna should be?
The floor is my dance floor. The sofa is also mine!
Meow. That means hurry up, probably!
I was not sleeping. I was planning dramatically!
Bring snacks and I might remember your name!
My whiskers predict a very silly winner!
I knocked over the rules. You are welcome!

name: Big Pink Sock
phrases: I am a big pink sock, and I have lost my other half!
Something smells funny. It might be my jokes!
I escaped the washing machine for this!
No feet allowed. This sock is on holiday!
I have no bones, but I have excellent dance moves!
My superpower is disappearing on laundry day!
Run faster! The spin cycle is starting!
I asked for fabric softener, not bananas!
I am pink, I am stretchy, and I am in charge!
Congratulations! You have been selected by laundry!

name: Queen Elizabeth II
phrases: One is ready for a rather spectacular dance!
Please bring the corgis. They are excellent judges!
A banana? How delightfully unexpected!
Royal announcement: everyone must do a silly wiggle!
One does not rush. One accelerates gracefully!
My hat has requested a round of applause!
Tea first, dramatic jumping second!
The royal wave is now a full-body workout!
Keep calm and watch the dancing hat!
By royal decree, it is your turn!

name: Elton John
phrases: These pink glasses can see a superstar coming!
I brought the sparkle. You bring the dance moves!
That banana needs a tiny glitter jacket!
My sunglasses are louder than the music!
The forest is my stage tonight!
Give me a big entrance and an even bigger wiggle!
I am running out of glitter. This is an emergency!
Your shoes have been invited to a dance party!
That was a five-star banana-powered performance!
Take a bow, superstar. It is your turn!

name: Trump
phrases: My hair has become its own campfire!
This is a tremendous banana. Very bendy!
My hair is doing all the warm-up exercises!
We need a bigger dance floor for this hairstyle!
Nobody told my hair to stop waving!
I came for the bananas and stayed for the wiggles!
That sprint deserves a very large silly trophy!
My tie is trying to win the race without me!
Please do not toast marshmallows on my hair!
The results are in. It is your turn to shine!

name: Koala (provisional)
phrases: I woke up especially for this dance!
Is that a banana? I ordered eucalyptus!
I am not a bear. I am a sleepy superstar!
My ears have their own fan club!
Running? I thought you said napping!
One little wiggle, then five minutes of rest!
I climbed all the way down for this!
Please bring a pillow to the finish line!
My fluffy ears are picking up winner signals!
Wake me when it is my turn. Oh, it is your turn!
